body.intent: Fix The daemon pins a full CPU core: on the 4-core VM rhiza daemon uses ~100% CPU continuously (120 CPU-minutes in 2 hours) because each poll (daemonPoll = 5s, internal/api/daemon.go) takes 10-15 s of work: it re-reads and re-folds the whole log and recomputes picks every time. A poll should be cheap when nothing changed: skip the fold/pick work when the log, git refs, run records and settings are unchanged since the last poll (cache keyed on their stamps), and measure a poll's cost in a test. Agents' rhiza apply calls on the same VM also take minutes under this load
